follow-up time: From 12-18 weeks gestation to 28 weeks gestation
outcome: Preference for elective repeat caesarean delivery
cohort: 212 pregnant women with one prior caesarean section.
finding: Women's preferences for mode of birth were not set in early pregnancy, with increasing uncertainty and a decrease in preference for trial of labour observed between the first and second trimester.
mod_finding: There was a decrease in preference for trial of labour from the first to second trimester.
